UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered field technician or administrator profile with role and employee badge.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Full name of the technician or administrator.

role.description: Assigned access role for the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

AdminGrant.title: AdminGrant
AdminGrant.description: Trusted administrator role grant keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the granted administrator.

grantedBy.description: UID of the administrator who granted this role.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

PoleInspection.title: PoleInspection
PoleInspection.description: Field technician pole maintenance and bulb/component replacement inspection record.

inspectionDate.description: Date of inspection and repair in YYYY-MM-DD format.

location.description: Street, sector, or feeder line location for the pole.

faultType.description: Classification of the fault observed on the pole.

partReplaced.description: Hardware component or bulb replaced during service.

remarks.description: Technician description, work summary, or field remarks.

status.description: Current resolution state of the pole repair.

technicianId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the submitting technician.

technicianName.description: Display name of the submitting technician.

technicianBadge.description: Employee badge ID of the submitting technician.

lastEditedByUid.description: UID of the administrator who last updated this report.

lastEditedByName.description: Name of the administrator who last updated this report.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was last modified.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile records containing role and PII (restricted to owner or admin).

/admins/{userId}.description: Trusted administrator grant documents keyed by UID.

/inspections/{inspectionId}.description: Pole inspection and repair reports submitted by technicians and managed by admins.
